svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #2183 · Add a three-way visual theme selector with Windows and liquid-glass themes
The portal had a single terminal-dark look baked into every stylesheet;
now Settings picks linux, windows or apple, each theme scoped to its own html[data-ui].
BEFORE
AFTER
One look for everyone
base.css :root tokens: Tokyo Night navy, Segoe UI
hard-coded #7aa2f7 / #bb9af7 tints across 13k lines of CSS
no way to opt into a different visual style
restyling means editing every legacy stylesheet
Settings > Appearance
rail position, host grouping, vim mode, voice hold
no theme control
ui_theme::UiTheme { Linux, Windows, Apple }
set_ui_theme -> html[data-ui=windows|apple]; Linux = none
index.html boot script applies it before first paint
localStorage claude-portal-ui-theme; per browser
apple fonts fetched only when apple is chosen
Theme stylesheets, all scoped to their data-ui
refresh/tokens + shell + transcript.css: liquid glass
themes/windows.css: Luna title bars, bevels, beige
selector cards with snarky labels + live swatches
Linux default: no attribute, legacy CSS untouched
Per-browser choice only (not synced to the account); backdrop-filter glass costs GPU on low-end devices, and themes override CSS rather than replace it.
